messages:
Aisha (PM): Heads-up — we need a quick alignment on the Q3 initiative that ties the new low-latency routing + dedicated capacity work. Customer asks are landing in enterprise deals and sales want clearer launch criteria.
Marco (Eng): +1. Main asks from eng: clear SLA targets, ramp plan for Dedicated, and who owns the canary/fallback flows.
Liang (Runtime): For runtime, we need expected request patterns (p50/p95 tokens, seq len) and target latency SLOs. Without that quantization/batching knobs change.
Sam (Infra): Infra question: do we provision more dedicated GPU pools now or rely on burst for launch? provisioning lead time is ~6 weeks for new capacity in cluster.
Priya (Security): Also need to confirm data residency for early enterprise customers. Private deployments will need KMS/HSM integration checklist signed off before canary.
Tam (PMM): Sales feedback: top customers want hard numbers — expected requests/sec and cost delta vs hosted. They need a one-pager to sign off deals.
Aisha (PM): Proposed working assumptions: launch must meet <=120ms p95 for short-gen (<=256 tokens), canary to 5% of traffic with auto-fallback to larger region. We also require end-to-end audit logs for Private by GA. Thoughts?
Marco (Eng): 120ms p95 is tight but doable on quantized variants with KV caching. We'll need runtime + infra to enable prefix caching and a canary route that pins to Dedicated.
Liang (Runtime): Agree — to hit 120ms p95 we should enable continuous batching with max_batch=8 and aggressive KV-cache hits for similar prefixes. Need perf validation: I'll schedule a 3-day perf spike to get realistic numbers.
Sam (Infra): If we dedicate GPU pools, we need commit windows and a fallback routing policy. Alternative: start with burstable pools for first month while we validate perf.
Priya (Security): For audit/KMS, we can surface a minimal checklist: 1) KMS integration (customer key), 2) audit log schema, 3) network isolation doc. Security review takes ~2 weeks after checklist is complete.
Tam (PMM): Can we get a short latency/cost tradeoff table for sales? Example rows: hosted baseline, dedicated (quantized), dedicated (float16). Even rough numbers help.
Aisha (PM): Owners: Marco -> overall launch engineering, Liang -> runtime perf & canary config, Sam -> infra provisioning & routing, Priya -> security checklist. I'll own launch criteria and sales one-pager.
Marco (Eng): Staffing ask: we might need 0.5 FTE infra eng for two sprints to wire up the dedicated pools and routing. Can we get contractor support?
Sam (Infra): We can allocate a platform contractor for ramp if approved. Need cost approval from finance. Also need the region list for provisioning (US-west, EU-west first).
Liang (Runtime): Perf spike plan: 1) baseline with hosted config, 2) quantized model w/ batching, 3) KV cache enabled. Data needed: synthetic traces and one customer prompt set. Can Aisha share the prompt set?
Aisha (PM): Sharing customer prompt set now in private drive link: https://redwood/internal/q3-enterprise-prompts — please treat as restricted.
Priya (Security): Note: customer prompt sets must go through DLP scan before being used in perf clusters. Ping me when it's uploaded.
Tam (PMM): For the sales one-pager, I can draft an outline by EOD: TL;DR, perf numbers, expected uplift, billing model, pre-reqs.
Marco (Eng): Quick technical question: what is the canary rollback policy? auto-roll back on 5xx spike or latency >2x baseline for 5m?
Liang (Runtime): Recommend policy: auto-fallback on error rate delta >2% absolute or p95 >1.5x baseline for 3 consecutive minutes, with immediate alert to oncall.
Sam (Infra): We also need a routing policy implementation: prefer Dedicated, fallback to Hosted regionally, then cross-region. Will add circuit-breaker thresholds.
Aisha (PM): Timeline proposal: Week 0-1: perf spike & checklist draft; Week 2: infra provisioning + canary infra ready; Week 3: canary rollout 5% and metrics review; Week 4: expand to 50% if stable; GA tentative end of Week 6.
Priya (Security): Timeline OK, but security review will need the checklist completed by end of Week 1 to hit Week 2 gating. I'll block time for review.
Tam (PMM): I'll sync with sales to freeze the two pilot customers — need legal to sign a short pilot agreement. Sales are on standby for dates.
Marco (Eng): Risks: 1) Perf not meeting 120ms p95 on quantized models for long-tail prompts; 2) Infra lead time delaying canary; 3) Security signoff delays. Mitigations: extra perf days, burst pools, and early security checklist.
Aisha (PM): Decision points for Thursday: a) approve 0.5 FTE contractor for infra for 4 weeks, b) green-light perf spike access to customer prompts (with DLP), c) accept latency target 120ms p95 as goal but label as 'target' not hard-block. Can we decide?
Sam (Infra): I approve contractor request pending finance sign-off. I'll open a ticket to request funds.
Priya (Security): I approve DLP scan and will expedite review once prompt set is uploaded.
Tam (PMM): Sales will pause offers until we have numbers, but will accept the target as marketing copy as 'target p95'.
Marco (Eng): I'm in for the perf spike — will need two engineers allocated for the 3-day run.
Liang (Runtime): I'll schedule perf cluster and start tests Wednesday morning.
Aisha (PM): Great — next steps: Marco to create engineering spike ticket, Sam to open infra funding ticket, Priya to confirm DLP window, Tam to draft one-pager. Meeting Friday 10am to review spike results.
deploy-bot: scheduled-deploy: perf-spike-cluster -> queued (eta 02:00 UTC)
Aisha (PM): Thanks all. I'll follow up with invites and the checklist doc.
Marco (Eng): Thanks — will post results in this thread.
Liang (Runtime): Will share perf dashboards and raw numbers.
Sam (Infra): I'll add routing draft to the infra repo and link here.
Priya (Security): Ping me when draft checklist is in the doc, will iterate quickly.
Tam (PMM): On it.
Aisha (PM): Closing the loop — everyone please react with :thumbsup: if aligned.
Marco (Eng): :thumbsup:
Liang (Runtime): :thumbsup:
Sam (Infra): :thumbsup:
Priya (Security): :thumbsup:
